title: Batched Multi-Site health-history persistence
opportunity: RecordHealthHistoryAsync issued one INSERT round-trip per upstream before trimming history, increasing latency and timeout risk for multi-upstream Sites.
implementation: Replaced per-observation ExecuteNonQueryAsync calls with one NpgsqlBatch inside the existing transaction.
Kept parameterized values, the existing bounded retention trim, transaction commit, cancellation, and empty-observation fast path unchanged.
Added a source contract requiring NpgsqlBatch and rejecting per-row execution.

verification.databaseIntegration: Not executed because PostgreSQL is unavailable at 127.0.0.1:5432 in this environment

boundary: Live PostgreSQL batch execution and query-plan/latency benchmark
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
